verdict_reason: The .sav (206 rows) holds RB12Mean, FSMean, Condition and Include1; the audit script's Student t-test on learning (RB12Mean - FSMean) among the 158 included gives t(156)=-1.318, p=.189, matching the table and report; the pooled d is -0.21 as in the table, though the script's own ES line would give -0.10 (see obstacles).

data_files.notes: Include1 0 = 'Include for analyses' (158 rows, 79 per condition). Condition 1 achievement priming, 2 control. Precomputed 'Learning' = FSMean - RB12Mean (exact negative of the script's mean.learn).

data_files.path: Dataset/SPSS Analysis syntax replication of Study 2 Eitam et al 2008 PS.sps

key_test.test: independent-samples Student t-test (var.equal=TRUE), mean.learn = RB12Mean - FSMean by Condition, rows with Include1 == 'Include for analyses'

recompute.result: t(156)=-1.318, p=.1894, pooled d=-0.21 (2t/sqrt(N)); script's ES line des(t/sqrt(n)) gives -0.105

obstacles: Audit script ES is wrong by a factor of two: it passes t/sqrt(N) as d to compute.es::des with n1=n2=N; the table's -0.21 matches the report, not the script
Sign of d depends on condition order; table and report use prime minus control on RT-based learning
